about: Every revision of en.wikipedia.org "2026–27 European windstorm season" (page 83624065), oldest first: id, parent, time (UTC), bytes of the whole page, the edit summary, and for revisions since 8 November 2026 the sha256 of the wikitext, its footnotes and the bytes of the storm's own section. No editor's name or address is requested or kept; summaries that name an editor (reverts) are withheld. Appended on each read, never rewritten. Text of Wikipedia is CC BY-SA 4.0; none is copied here beyond edit summaries.
